summary: Crinetics Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K disclosing supplemental proxy disclosures in connection with its pending acquisition by Vertex Pharmaceuticals via a merger agreement dated July 6, 2026. The special meeting to approve the merger is set for August 28, 2026. Three shareholder complaints and demand letters allege misleading disclosures; Crinetics denies merit but voluntarily supplements disclosures to avoid delay. The merger is structured as a cash tender offer for all shares, though specific terms were not in the excerpt. Watch for shareholder vote outcome and potential injunction risk; risk-arb angle centers on closing conditions and litigation resolution.
